pairs.target: xiān chuánlái de shì mùlún de zhīya shēng .
pairs.english: First came the creak of wooden wheels.
pairs.hanzi: 先传来的是木轮的吱呀声。

pairs.target: lín zhào táiqǐ tóu , shēngyīn què tíng le .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao raised her head, but the sound stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 林照抬起头，声音却停了。

pairs.target: chēzhé lìngyìtóu yǒu cǎocóng dǎng zhe , guò le yíhuìer , cái yǒurén shuō : " zhèbiān yě yào diàn , zuóér xiǎnxiē zhé le zhóu . "
pairs.english: Grass screened the far end of the cart track; after a while someone finally said, “This bit needs filling too; nearly broke the axle yesterday.”
pairs.hanzi: 车辙另一头有草丛挡着，过了一会儿，才有人说：“这边也要垫，昨儿险些折了轴。”

pairs.target: shítou pèng zài yìqǐ , kǎ de yìshēng .
pairs.english: Stones knocked together with one clack.
pairs.hanzi: 石头碰在一起，咔的一声。

pairs.target: tā zuàn zhe shuǐnáng , xiǎng yìng , hóulóng lǐ zhǐ cā chū yìdiǎn qì .
pairs.english: Gripping the waterskin, she tried to answer; her throat scraped out only a little breath.
pairs.hanzi: 她攥着水囊，想应，喉咙里只擦出一点气。

pairs.target: yíliàng kōng bǎnchē cóng cǎo hòu zhuǎn chūlái .
pairs.english: An empty flatbed handcart came around from behind the grass.
pairs.hanzi: 一辆空板车从草后转出来。

pairs.target: qiántou lāchē de rén gōng zhe bèi , jiānshàng shéngtào mó dé fābái , hòutou nà rén bào le jǐkuài suìshí , yánlù wǎng chēzhé shēnchù tián .
pairs.english: At the front, the man pulling the cart bent his back, the rope loop on his shoulder worn pale; behind him, another man carried several broken stones, filling the deeper parts of the ruts along the way.
pairs.hanzi: 前头拉车的人弓着背，肩上绳套磨得发白，后头那人抱了几块碎石，沿路往车辙深处填。

pairs.target: chēlún yà guò yíchù xīn diàn de dìfāng , huàng le yíxià , yòu wěnzhù .
pairs.english: A wheel rolled over a newly filled spot, wobbled once, then steadied.
pairs.hanzi: 车轮轧过一处新垫的地方，晃了一下，又稳住。

pairs.target: tā rènde zhèzhǒng chē .
pairs.english: She recognized that kind of cart.
pairs.hanzi: 她认得这种车。

pairs.target: chéngxī xiè shíliào de chǎngzi lǐ , yě yǒurén zài chēzhóu shàng chán jiù máshéng , shěngde níshā jìnqù .
pairs.english: At the yards west of town where stone was unloaded, people also wrapped old hemp rope around cart axles to stop grit getting in.
pairs.hanzi: 城西卸石料的场子里，也有人在车轴上缠旧麻绳，省得泥砂进去。

pairs.target: chēzi zhèng cháo zhèbiān lái .
pairs.english: The cart was coming toward her.
pairs.hanzi: 车子正朝这边来。

pairs.target: lín zhào sōngkāi shuǐnáng , táiqǐ shǒu , jǔ búdào jiāntóu , biàn luò zài xī shàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao let go of the waterskin and lifted her hand; before she could raise it to shoulder height, it dropped onto her knee.
pairs.hanzi: 林照松开水囊，抬起手，举不到肩头，便落在膝上。

pairs.target: tā yòu tái le yícì .
pairs.english: She lifted it once more.
pairs.hanzi: 她又抬了一次。

pairs.target: tián shítou de rén zhí qǐ yāo , wàng guòlái , shǒulǐ shèngxià de liǎngkuài méi fàng .
pairs.english: The man filling the track with stones straightened and looked over without putting down the last two in his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 填石头的人直起腰，望过来，手里剩下的两块没放。

pairs.target: " nàér yǒurén . "
pairs.english: “Someone over there.”
pairs.hanzi: “那儿有人。”

pairs.target: lāchē de niǔguòtóu , xiān kànjiàn tā de xié , zài shùnzhe wǎng shàng kàn .
pairs.english: The man pulling turned his head, saw her shoes first, then looked upward from there.
pairs.hanzi: 拉车的扭过头，先看见她的鞋，再顺着往上看。

pairs.target: shéngtào cóng tā jiānshàng huáxiàlái , tā shēnshǒu lāo zhù , jiào hòutou de rén bǎ chē dǐ hǎo .
pairs.english: The rope loop slipped from his shoulder; he reached to catch it and told the man behind to brace the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 绳套从他肩上滑下来，他伸手捞住，叫后头的人把车抵好。

pairs.target: " gūniáng ? "
pairs.english: “Miss?”
pairs.hanzi: “姑娘？”

pairs.target: tā diǎn le yíxiàtóu .
pairs.english: She nodded her head once.
pairs.hanzi: 她点了一下头。

pairs.target: nà rén dào le jìnqián , shēnshàng yǒu gǔ shài rè de mábù wèi , kùjiǎo quán shì shífěn .
pairs.english: The man came close, a scent of sun-warmed hemp cloth about him, his trouser cuffs all coated in stone dust.
pairs.hanzi: 那人到了近前，身上有股晒热的麻布味，裤脚全是石粉。

pairs.target: tā dūnxià shí , lín zhào bùyóudé wǎng yánshí shàng suō , yāo cè yì téng , yòu tíngzhù le .
pairs.english: When he crouched, Lin Zhao shrank involuntarily against the rock; a stab of pain in her side stopped her again.
pairs.hanzi: 他蹲下时，林照不由得往岩石上缩，腰侧一疼，又停住了。

pairs.target: tā kànzhe tā yī shàng de ànsè , méi shēnshǒu lā .
pairs.english: He looked at the dark stains on her clothes, without reaching to pull her up.
pairs.hanzi: 他看着她衣上的暗色，没伸手拉。

pairs.target: " shāng zài nǎér ? "
pairs.english: “Where are you hurt?”
pairs.hanzi: “伤在哪儿？”

pairs.target: tā de shǒu àn dào yāojiān .
pairs.english: Her hand pressed her waist.
pairs.hanzi: 她的手按到腰间。

pairs.target: tā dītóu kàn le yìyǎn , huíshēn biàn hǎn : " bié tuīguòlái !
pairs.english: He glanced down, then turned and called, “Don't push it over here!”
pairs.hanzi: 他低头看了一眼，回身便喊：“别推过来！

pairs.target: xiān bǎ nǐ nà jiàn guàzǐ nálái , diàn chē . "
pairs.english: “Bring that jacket of yours first, to pad the cart.”
pairs.hanzi: 先把你那件褂子拿来，垫车。”

pairs.target: tián shítou de rén diūxià suìshí , náxià dā zài chēbǎ shàng de hòu guà .
pairs.english: The man filling the track dropped his stones and took down the thick jacket hanging from the cart handle.
pairs.hanzi: 填石头的人丢下碎石，拿下搭在车把上的厚褂。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén bǎ chē lā dào jiào píng de dìfāng , mùlún qiánhòu dōu sāi le shítou , cái yìtóng zǒu huílái .
pairs.english: The two men pulled the cart onto a flatter patch, wedged stones both before and behind the wooden wheels, then came back together.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人把车拉到较平的地方，木轮前后都塞了石头，才一同走回来。

pairs.target: lín zhào kànjiàn tāmen de shǒu , yìshuāng liè zhe kǒu , yìshuāng zhǐjiǎ fènglǐ jīmǎn huī .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao saw their hands: one pair cracked, the other pair with dust packed beneath the nails.
pairs.hanzi: 林照看见他们的手，一双裂着口，一双指甲缝里积满灰。

pairs.target: fāngcái zài yuǎnchù , tā zhǐpà tāmen kànbújiàn zìjǐ , rújīn rén zhēn dào le yǎnqián , què bù zhīdào dìyījù gāi shuō shénme .
pairs.english: A moment ago, at a distance, she'd feared only that they wouldn't see her; now they really were before her, yet she didn't know what to say first.
pairs.hanzi: 方才在远处，她只怕他们看不见自己，如今人真到了眼前，却不知道第一句该说什么。

pairs.target: " wǒ …… diàoxiàlái le . "
pairs.english: “I… fell.”
pairs.hanzi: “我……掉下来了。”

pairs.target: tā de mùguāng nuó dào shēnpáng de pō shàng , méi zài wǎnghòu kàn .
pairs.english: Her gaze moved to the slope beside her; she didn't look back again.
pairs.hanzi: 她的目光挪到身旁的坡上，没再往后看。

pairs.target: " shuāi de ? "
pairs.english: “A fall?”
pairs.hanzi: “摔的？”

pairs.target: nà rén yě táitóu wànglewàng ,
pairs.english: The man looked up too.
pairs.hanzi: 那人也抬头望了望，

pairs.target: " nǐ gēn shuí lái de ? "
pairs.english: “Who did you come with?”
pairs.hanzi: “你跟谁来的？”

pairs.target: lín zhào zhāng kāikǒu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao opened her mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 林照张开口。

pairs.target: shào píng de míngzì yǐjīng dào le shéjiān , hòumiàn què gēnzhe nà dào láng , chuāngyán , háiyǒu wò zài gēbo shàng de shǒu .
pairs.english: Shao Ping's name had already reached the tip of her tongue; behind it, though, came that gallery, the window ledge, and the hand gripping her arm.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平的名字已经到了舌尖，后面却跟着那道廊、窗沿，还有握在胳膊上的手。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xiàbā shōuhuí qù , zhǐ yáotóu .
pairs.english: She drew in her chin and only shook her head.
pairs.hanzi: 她把下巴收回去，只摇头。

pairs.target: " xiān bié wèn le . "
pairs.english: “Leave the questions for now,”
pairs.hanzi: “先别问了。”

pairs.target: ná guàzǐ de rén shuō ,
pairs.english: said the man with the jacket,
pairs.hanzi: 拿褂子的人说，

pairs.target: " pénglǐ háiyǒu rén . "
pairs.english: “There's still someone at the sheds.”
pairs.hanzi: “棚里还有人。”

pairs.target: tāmen shāngliáng zhe zěnme tái .
pairs.english: They discussed how to lift her.
pairs.hanzi: 他们商量着怎么抬。

pairs.target: lín zhào tīngdéchū , lāchē de xiǎng yígè rén bào tā , lìng yígè bùkěn , shuō yāo shàng yǒushāng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao could tell that the man pulling the cart wanted to carry her alone, while the other objected, saying her waist was injured.
pairs.hanzi: 林照听得出，拉车的想一个人抱她，另一个不肯，说腰上有伤。

pairs.target: zuìhòu liǎng rén yìqiányīhòu dūn hǎo , ràng tā shāoshāo qiánqīng , shǒu shēn dào yèxià hé xīwān , hǎn le yìshēng , cái mànmàn bǎ tā yí qǐlái .
pairs.english: In the end they crouched, one in front and one behind, had her lean forward a little, and slid their hands beneath her armpits and knees; then, calling out once, they slowly lifted her.
pairs.hanzi: 最后两人一前一后蹲好，让她稍稍前倾，手伸到腋下和膝弯，喊了一声，才慢慢把她移起来。

alignment.english: one in front and one behind

pairs.target: tā zhuāzhù le jìnchù nà rén de xiùzǐ .
pairs.english: She seized the sleeve of the man nearest her.
pairs.hanzi: 她抓住了近处那人的袖子。

pairs.target: jiǎo lí dì yǐhòu , yāo shàng xiàng bèi chóngxīn sīkāi .
pairs.english: Once her feet left the ground, her waist felt as if it were being torn open anew.
pairs.hanzi: 脚离地以后，腰上像被重新撕开。

pairs.target: tā tīngjiàn zìjǐ xīqì de shēngyīn , duǎn dé jiē bú shàngxià yìkǒu , shǒuzhǐ biàn yuè zuàn yuè jǐn .
pairs.english: She heard the sound of her own drawn breaths, too short to join the next; then her fingers gripped ever tighter.
pairs.hanzi: 她听见自己吸气的声音，短得接不上下一口，手指便越攥越紧。

pairs.target: nà rén méiyǒu cuī , zhǐ ràng tóngbàn tíng yi tíng .
pairs.english: The man didn't hurry her, only told his companion to pause.
pairs.hanzi: 那人没有催，只让同伴停一停。

pairs.target: hòu guà pù zài bǎnchē shàng , xiùzǐ zhé chéng yìtuán , diàn zhù tā de jiān .
pairs.english: The thick jacket lay on the cart, its sleeves folded into a bundle to cushion her shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 厚褂铺在板车上，袖子折成一团，垫住她的肩。

pairs.target: tā cè zhe tǎng xià , liǎngtiáotuǐ quán zhe , hǎo yíhuìer cái sōngkāi biérén de yīxiù .
pairs.english: She lay on her side with both legs curled up; after a long while she finally let go of the other person's sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 她侧着躺下，两条腿蜷着，好一会儿才松开别人的衣袖。

pairs.target: " dōngxī ……"
pairs.english: “My things…”

pairs.target: " dōu zài .
pairs.english: “All here.”
pairs.hanzi: “都在。

pairs.target: shuǐdài , yāodài . "
pairs.english: “Water bag, pouch.”
pairs.hanzi: 水袋，腰袋。”

pairs.target: nà rén yíyàngyàng zhǐ gěi tā kàn , yòu jiāng shuǐnáng fàngdào tā shǒubiān ,
pairs.english: The man pointed out each one for her to see, then put the waterskin beside her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 那人一样样指给她看，又将水囊放到她手边，

pairs.target: " shǎobùliǎo nǐ de . "
pairs.english: “You won't lose a thing.”
pairs.hanzi: “少不了你的。”

pairs.target: chē dòng qǐlái shí , tā háishì shēnshǒu qù mō le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: When the cart started, she still reached to check them once.
pairs.hanzi: 车动起来时，她还是伸手去摸了一遍。

pairs.target: lúnzǐ měi diān yíxià , chē bǎn biàn cóng jiān bèi xià zhuàng shànglái .
pairs.english: Each time the wheels jolted, the cart bed would strike upward from beneath her shoulders and back.
pairs.hanzi: 轮子每颠一下，车板便从肩背下撞上来。

pairs.target: tuīchē de rén zǒu dé hěn màn , yùjiàn tū shí , xiān tíngxiàlái bānkāi .
pairs.english: The man pushing walked very slowly; when he met a protruding stone, he stopped to move it first.
pairs.hanzi: 推车的人走得很慢，遇见凸石，先停下来搬开。

pairs.target: lín zhào wàng zhe chēyán nà dào lièfèng , shǔbùqīng tíng guò jǐhuí ,
pairs.english: Watching that crack along the cart's edge, Lin Zhao couldn't count how many stops there had been.
pairs.hanzi: 林照望着车沿那道裂缝，数不清停过几回，

pairs.target: zhǐ jìde yǒu yìhuí chē bú dòng le hěn jiǔ , qiántou zài qiāo shénme , suíhòu nà rén līn zhe yíkuài jiānshí zǒukāi , shǒu bèishàng duō le yìtiáo bái yìn .
pairs.english: She remembered only one time when the cart halted for a long while, something being hammered up ahead, then the man walking away carrying a pointed stone, one new white mark on the back of his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 只记得有一回车不动了很久，前头在敲什么，随后那人拎着一块尖石走开，手背上多了一条白印。

alignment.english: on the back of his hand

pairs.target: tā xiǎng shuō búyòng , màn yìdiǎn jiù xíng .
pairs.english: She wanted to tell him not to bother; going a little slower would do.
pairs.hanzi: 她想说不用，慢一点就行。

pairs.target: zuǐchún dòngledòng , méiyǒu chū shēng .
pairs.english: Her lips moved, but no sound came.
pairs.hanzi: 嘴唇动了动，没有出声。

pairs.target: lù jiànjiàn píng le .
pairs.english: The road gradually leveled out.
pairs.hanzi: 路渐渐平了。

pairs.target: fēng lǐ duō le chuīyān wèi , yuǎnchù yǒurén gǎn shēngkǒu , biān shāo zài kōngzhōng xiǎng le yíjì .
pairs.english: The wind gained the scent of cooking smoke; someone drove animals in the distance, and a whip cracked once in the air.
pairs.hanzi: 风里多了炊烟味，远处有人赶牲口，鞭梢在空中响了一记。

pairs.target: tā zhēngkāiyǎn , kànjiàn yìpái ǎi péng , yánxià liàngzhe huībái de wéiqún , pángbiān mǎ le shí tiáo .
pairs.english: She opened her eyes and saw a row of low sheds, gray-white aprons drying under the eaves and stone blocks stacked nearby.
pairs.hanzi: 她睁开眼，看见一排矮棚，檐下晾着灰白的围裙，旁边码了石条。

pairs.target: yǒurén cóng péng kǒu tàntóu , shǒulǐ hái duān zhe fànwǎn .
pairs.english: Someone peered out of a shed doorway, still carrying a bowl of food in one hand.
pairs.hanzi: 有人从棚口探头，手里还端着饭碗。

pairs.target: " zěnme le ? "
pairs.english: “What's happened?”
pairs.hanzi: “怎么了？”

pairs.target: " chàdào shàng jiǎn de , shāng dé bù qīng .
pairs.english: “Found her along the side track; she's badly hurt.”
pairs.hanzi: “岔道上捡的，伤得不轻。

pairs.target: yī péng kāi zhe méi ? "
pairs.english: “Is the treatment shed open?”
pairs.hanzi: 医棚开着没？”

pairs.target: nà zhī fànwǎn wǎng lǐ yì suō , rén yǐjīng pǎo kāi .
pairs.english: The bowl jerked back inside, and its owner had already run off.
pairs.hanzi: 那只饭碗往里一缩，人已经跑开。

pairs.target: bǎnchē tíng zài dìèrjiān péngwài .
pairs.english: The cart stopped just outside the second shed.
pairs.hanzi: 板车停在第二间棚外。

pairs.target: lín zhào bèi yí dào zhǎi chuángshàng , yǎnqián de tiān huànchéng le yípiàn jiù bù dǐng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao was moved onto a narrow bed; the sky before her eyes became a stretch of old canvas roof.
pairs.hanzi: 林照被移到窄床上，眼前的天换成了一片旧布顶。

pairs.target: yǒurén bǎ guàzǐ cóng tā jiān xià chōuzǒu , yòu gài lái yìchuáng báobèi .
pairs.english: Someone pulled the jacket from beneath her shoulder, then covered her with a thin quilt.
pairs.hanzi: 有人把褂子从她肩下抽走，又盖来一床薄被。

pairs.target: tā zhuāzhù bèi jiǎo , tīngjiàn pángbiān dǎoshuǐ , tóngpén kē zài dèng shàng , shēngyīn hěn jìn .
pairs.english: Grasping a corner of the quilt, she heard water being poured nearby and a copper basin knocking against a stool; the sound was very close.
pairs.hanzi: 她抓住被角，听见旁边倒水，铜盆磕在凳上，声音很近。

pairs.target: yígè wǎn zhe xiùzǐ de fùrén fǔshēn guòlái , xiān jiào tā zhēngyǎn , yòu wèn tā tīng bu tīngdéjiàn .
pairs.english: A woman with her sleeves rolled up leaned over, first told her to open her eyes, then asked if she could hear.
pairs.hanzi: 一个挽着袖子的妇人俯身过来，先叫她睁眼，又问她听不听得见。

pairs.target: tā yìng le , fùrén cái xiānkāi bèi jiǎo , mùguāng shùnzhe tā àn zài yāojiān de shǒu luòxiàqù .
pairs.english: She answered; the woman then lifted the quilt's corner, her gaze falling along Lin Zhao's hand pressed to her waist.
pairs.hanzi: 她应了，妇人才掀开被角，目光顺着她按在腰间的手落下去。

pairs.target: " zhè shì nǐ zìjǐ zā de ? "
pairs.english: “Did you tie this yourself?”
pairs.hanzi: “这是你自己扎的？”

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu .
pairs.english: She nodded.
pairs.hanzi: 她点头。

pairs.target: fùrén mō dào bùdài qiántou de jié , shì le yíxià , biàn tíngzhù , zhuǎnshēn jiào rén ná jiǎnzǐ hé wēnshuǐ .
pairs.english: The woman felt the knot at the front of the cloth belt, tried it once, then stopped and turned, asking someone to bring scissors and warm water.
pairs.hanzi: 妇人摸到布带前头的结，试了一下，便停住，转身叫人拿剪子和温水。

pairs.target: lín zhào de shǒu yíxià yājǐn le .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao's hand pressed tight at once.
pairs.hanzi: 林照的手一下压紧了。

pairs.target: " bié chě . "
pairs.english: “Don't pull.”
pairs.hanzi: “别扯。”

pairs.target: " zhīdào . "
pairs.english: “I know.”
pairs.hanzi: “知道。”

pairs.target: fùrén tái yǎnkàn tā ,
pairs.english: The woman looked up at her.
pairs.hanzi: 妇人抬眼看她，

pairs.target: " wǒ xiānjiǎn dàizǐ , bú dòng lǐmiàn nà kuài . "
pairs.english: “I will cut the belt first, without touching the bit underneath.”
pairs.hanzi: “我先剪带子，不动里面那块。”

pairs.target: tā réng méi sōngshǒu .
pairs.english: She still didn't move her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 她仍没松手。

pairs.target: fùrén děng zhe , jiǎnzǐ gē zài yìpáng , méiyǒu pèng tā .
pairs.english: The woman waited, scissors set aside, without touching her.
pairs.hanzi: 妇人等着，剪子搁在一旁，没有碰她。

pairs.target: péngwài chuánlái tuīchērén shuōhuà de shēngyīn : " jiù jiùliào dào nàbiān , kào shítou zuò zhe .
pairs.english: From outside the shed came the sound of the cart man speaking: “Just over by the old stone track, sitting against a rock.”
pairs.hanzi: 棚外传来推车人说话的声音：“就旧料道那边，靠石头坐着。

pairs.target: méi jiàn háiyǒu shuí . "
pairs.english: “Didn't see anyone else.”
pairs.hanzi: 没见还有谁。”

pairs.target: lìng yígè rén wèn le jù shénme , tā méiyǒu tīng qīng .
pairs.english: Someone else asked a question she didn't catch.
pairs.hanzi: 另一个人问了句什么，她没有听清。

pairs.target: lín zhào wàng zhe miànqián de fùrén , guò le piànkè , shǒu cái mànmàn nuókāi .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao watched the woman before her; after a while, her hand finally moved slowly away.
pairs.hanzi: 林照望着面前的妇人，过了片刻，手才慢慢挪开。

pairs.target: bèi jiǎo hái zuàn zài lìngyìzhī shǒulǐ , cūbù tiēzhe zhǎngxīn , jìngshì gān de .
pairs.english: The quilt's corner was still gripped in her other hand; against her palm, the coarse cloth was actually dry.
pairs.hanzi: 被角还攥在另一只手里，粗布贴着掌心，竟是干的。
